itens.titulo: TSMC's Record Q3 Earnings & Upbeat Outlook Put These ETFs in Focus
itens.descricao: TSMC's Record Q3 Earnings & Upbeat Outlook Put These ETFs in Focus Yahoo Finance
trechos: TSMC Beats Q3 Earnings Estimates TSMC's third-quarter revenues of NT$1.49 trillion ($46.36 billion) topped the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $45.62 billion.
TSMC reported third-quarter 2026 earnings per share (EPS) of $4.60, ahead of the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $4.45.
TSMC's net profit climbed 68.7% year over year, marking its sixth consecutive quarter of record earnings, per CNBC.
Its operating margin reached 58.7%, surpassing the upper end of the company's guidance range of 58%.
Strong Q4 Outlook Signals Sustained AI Momentum TSMC expects fourth-quarter revenues of $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion.
At the midpoint, the forecast implies a 14% sequential increase and a 58% jump from the year-ago quarter, according to the company's earnings call.
The forecast beats the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $48.78 billion.
The chipmaker also expects capital expenditure during 2026-2028 to be significantly higher than in the preceding three years as it expands capacity to meet rising customer demand.

trechos: Quick Read - Bitcoin trades at $82,306, up 30% over two months, but remains down 7% for the year as major options expiries loom.
- The $79,806 low from October 15 is the critical support level, and a close below it would mark the first serious test of Bitcoin's two-month rally.

Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) traders are closely watching two key dates on Deribit, the largest Bitcoin options exchange: a weekly expiry on October 16, 2026, and the major monthly expiry on October 30.
As these dates approach, there are often warnings about billions of dollars' worth of contracts set to expire, with emphasis on a "max pain" price that Bitcoin supposedly gravitates towards.
As of October 15, Bitcoin is trading at $82,306, having dipped to a 24-hour low of $79,806 before rebounding.
This recovery fits a pattern from the past two months, during which Bitcoin has risen by 29.9%.
However, it is still down 6.7% for the year and has dropped 26.3% compared to the same time last year.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin Price Rebound Faces a Fresh $82K Test: Will It Survive the Weekend?
itens.descricao: Bitcoin Price Rebound Faces a Fresh $82K Test: Will It Survive the Weekend? Yahoo Finance
trechos: BTC USD trades at $81,965, up 1.67% over 24 hours, after slipping back below the $82,000 handle it reclaimed on Friday morning.
The bounce followed US inflation reaching 3.7% and a sharp move in Treasury yields, against a significant flush of leveraged long positions.
Avinash Shekhar, co-founder and CEO of Pi42, notes that $82,000 has acted as both support and resistance for close to 50 days, which makes a weekend close on either side of it genuinely informative.
BTC USD Back Above $80K: What the Rebound Was Actually Built On Thursday's drop to roughly $79,800 wiped out about $930 million in leveraged positions, with around $780 million of that in longs.
On the way back up, roughly $53 million in shorts were liquidated.
Glassnode's heatmap showed a thick wall of bids resting at $80,000 for much of last week.

CryptoQuant's measure of total whale holdings, which excludes exchange and mining pool addresses, has climbed steeply since September and now sits close to three million BTC, near its highest of 2026.
Volume fell 23.87% to $30.98 billion while price recovered, so the bounce is arriving on lighter participation than the decline that caused it.
